evidence.detail: The main logged-in render path in rs/l/b/a calls rs/l/b/c.a(Client) as the world-scene phase; rs/l/b/c is therefore live frame rendering authority rather than an orphan graphics helper.

rs/l/b/c computes the active camera pitch/yaw/position from Client state, applies the five camera-shake channels, derives the viewport projection and drives the world-scene draw path before restoring the prior camera state.
R133 independently proved that this class consumes Client.aa ScenePolygonManager records, creates scene Graphics2D and renders their live polygons with fill/outline colors after world projection.

After scene/world overlay work, the same render phase invokes the adjacent HUD/gameframe renderer rs/l/b/b and then the remaining client post-scene presentation hooks, distinguishing it from the R302 InterfaceRenderer.

proposals.note: Descriptive semantic recovery from exact-v308 logged-in world-scene/camera rendering behavior; original stripped source identifier is not claimed.
